title: Checkerboard Parity Balance
statement:
An alternating tile grid of size R x C contains black and white tiles. A cell (r, c) is considered black if (r + c) is even, and white if (r + c) is odd.

Given an R x C matrix of integer values, calculate the absolute difference between the sum of values on all black cells and the sum of values on all white cells:
| Sum(Black Cells) - Sum(White Cells) |.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers R and C.
Next R lines: C space-separated integers.

sampleCases.explanation: Black cells: (0,0)=1, (1,1)=4 (sum=5). White cells: (0,1)=2, (1,0)=3 (sum=5). Diff = |5 - 5| = 0? Wait, black: 1+4=5, white: 2+3=5. Diff = 0.
Black cells (5 cells): 1+1+1+1+1 = 5. White cells (4 cells): 2+2+2+2 = 8. |5 - 8| = 3.
